reports.title: Colts Era Lab
reports.publicQuestion: Which Colts front office actually built the best era?
reports.subject: Indianapolis Colts
reports.subtitle: Polian vs. Grigson vs. Ballard
reports.summary: Why the best talent evaluator did not build the best team—and why Polian's advantage was more than Peyton Manning.
reports.fanSummary: Polian built the strongest complete organization. Grigson was better than remembered. Ballard found good players but struggled to turn that talent into sustained winning.

reports.title: Detroit Lions Turnaround
reports.publicQuestion: Who actually changed the Detroit Lions?
reports.subject: Detroit Lions
reports.subtitle: Millen vs. Mayhew vs. Quinn vs. Holmes
reports.summary: How Detroit went from 0–16 to a contender—and why the turnaround was bigger than one trade, one draft or one coach.
reports.fanSummary: Holmes built the strongest complete organization. Mayhew was much better than the playoff record suggests. Quinn had useful inputs but broke the conversion system. Millen had isolated hits that never compounded.

reports.title: Indiana Pacers Conversion Chain
reports.publicQuestion: How did the Pacers keep turning one star into the next?
reports.subject: Indiana Pacers
reports.subtitle: Paul George → Oladipo/Sabonis → Haliburton
reports.summary: How Indiana repeatedly preserved star value, changed basketball identities and reached the 2025 NBA Finals without rebuilding from zero for years.
reports.fanSummary: The Haliburton core has the highest ceiling and wins the published model, but the Paul George core remains a legitimate alternative if you value sustained floor, two-way peak quality and resilience more.
